user.title: Log in with Claude
user.description:
1. [Open this link]({url}) and log in with the Claude account you want to track.
2. Approve access. You are shown a code (it contains a `#`).
3. Paste the entire code below (or the full URL of the page).

Home Assistant gets its own login and does not share tokens with Claude Code or the Windows app.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in with Claude again
reauth_confirm.description: Access has expired or was revoked. [Open this link]({url}), log in with the **same** account and paste the code below.

reconfigure.title: Renew Claude login
reconfigure.description: [Open this link]({url}), log in with the same account and paste the code below.

error.missing_code: Paste the code from the login page.
error.state_mismatch: The code belongs to another login attempt. Use the link on this page.
error.invalid_code: The code was rejected or has expired. Open the link again and paste a new code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Claude. Try again shortly.

abort.already_configured: This Claude account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: You logged in with a different account than this entry tracks.

init.title: Claude Timer options
init.description: The usage API rate-limits hard (a block can last for hours), so keep the interval at 5 minutes or more.
